Fact: limitations
What to find: Known technical limitations, risks and failure modes.
Card sections that often contain it: Limitations, Bias, Risks and Limitations

Answer with status, value, quotes and section.

answer.value: Performance may degrade for languages other than English (trained primarily on English); less-represented English varieties may perform worse. The model may over- or under-represent groups or reinforce stereotypes, may produce inappropriate or offensive content, and can generate nonsensical or fabricated content that is inaccurate or outdated. Not suitable for medical diagnoses, legal advice, or financial planning.
quotes: Languages other than English may experience worse performance. English language varieties with less representation in the training data might experience worse performance than standard American English.
The model may over- or under-represent groups of people, erase representation of some groups, or reinforce demeaning or negative stereotypes.
The model may produce inappropriate or offensive content, which may make it inappropriate to deploy in sensitive contexts without additional mitigations specific to the use case.
Language models can generate nonsensical content or fabricate content that might sound reasonable but is inaccurate or outdated.
It is not suitable for providing medical diagnoses, legal advice, or financial planning.
